name: Opponent-adjusted QB evaluation, CFB (pass-defense strength faced)
census_status: EXTERNAL-REFERENCE — published ranks held as stamped instances; the adjustment method is the homed asset
stamp_required: EPA/dropback ranks + schedule-strength ranks, FBS games as of capture
stamp_gap: standing weekly series not ingested; only the 2026-10-15 published instance is held

record.source: X @ArkansasQuant, main post + self-reply table read 2026-10-15
record.method: never read a QB number raw: rank QB play (Pass EPA/dropback) AGAINST the strength of the pass defenses faced (schedule strength by EPA/dropback), and carry faced-vs-remaining slate context (counts of top-25 / top-50 pass defenses) with the rank
record.stamped_instance: through CFB Week 6, FBS games only, ranks among 138 FBS: USC the only top-10 QB-play team facing a top-10 slate (#7 QB play, #9 faced, #6 toughest remaining); Miami #2 QB play sees one top-25 pass defense all season; Georgia #8 has none remaining; Purdue #25 QB play after facing 3 top-25 pass defenses
record.nfl_port: the adjustment lens ports to NFL QB evaluation (QB EPA vs pass-defense strength faced) as a method; no NFL instance is claimed by this record
record.role: ratings-method reference (substrate): a standing instruction to opponent-adjust QB numbers before the reasoning layer reads them

methodology_fully_specified.opponent_adjustment: iterative ridge-style two-way fixed-effects adjustment, lambda = 50 plays, separating team strength from schedule strength — a team's numbers are re-expressed against the opponents that produced them
methodology_fully_specified.garbage_time_rule: plays outside the 5-95% win-probability band are excluded by default (garbage time does not grade teams or QBs)
methodology_fully_specified.matchup_projections: projected score = own offense + opponent defense - league average; the site posts its own line beside the market line, with two win-prob models (Pythagorean + normal) — the model-vs-market comparison is published, not hidden
methodology_fully_specified.glossary: 264 documented metrics, public on the site
methodology_fully_specified.data: CollegeFootballData.com public API + school sites + 247Sports Composite; the site states NO PFF grades or scouting data are used anywhere on it
methodology_fully_specified.cadence_caveat: FRESHNESS: the site's refresh is manually triggered, not scheduled — any instance pulled from it carries the pull date as its stamp, never an assumed currency

tranche2_enrichment.franchise_form: the author's recurring X franchise is the method in public: 'Are [offense/defense] ranks justified?' (rank vs quality faced + remaining) and faced/remaining slate tables (see C-284 enrichment)
